ideas.title: The 3AM Employee
ideas.concept: A split-screen post showing a business owner sleeping peacefully on one side, while on the other, an N8N workflow dashboard lights up processing leads, sending follow-ups via GoHighLevel, and drafting responses with Claude AI. Caption breaks down exactly what got automated and the hours saved per week.
ideas.hook: While you were sleeping, your business made 14 sales calls. Here's how.

ideas.title: Stop Hiring. Start Automating.
ideas.concept: A bold text-based carousel post listing 5 roles business owners keep hiring for (admin, lead follow-up, data entry, scheduling, reporting) and the exact automation stack that replaces each one. Visual: red 'X' through job titles with the tool logos stamped over them.
ideas.hook: That £30k assistant you're about to hire? Claude and N8N will do 80% of the job for £200/month.

ideas.title: The Automation Audit
ideas.concept: A short-form video or graphic where Alfie walks through a real client's chaotic pre-automation workflow (sticky notes, 14 browser tabs, missed follow-ups) versus the streamlined Google Workspace + GoHighLevel + Claude system after. Ends with a CTA to book a free audit.
ideas.hook: I looked at this business owner's daily workflow and nearly threw my laptop. Here's what we fixed in 7 days.
